5,Tseng Hao-Yuan,Software licence renewal,31200,invoice due 20 Nov

task: Add up every amount here that finance still has to pay out in November and name the lines that are not yet paid.
quote: Relocation advance (transfer to Taichung),90000,approved by HR 28 Oct
reason: The advance row is only partly sensitive: the purpose cell and HR status could be masked while the 90000 amount stays for the total, but the contract supports only whole-clause DROP and span-level placeholders on supported labels, not column-aware cell removal. The pair therefore uses a whole-row DROP in the second task and keeps the whole row in the first; a column-dependent variant is not representable.
